notes:
Venture 0.26 — terrain following is turned off for now

• Terrain following is switched off after two aircraft crashes. A terrain mission's heights are measured from sea level, and just after power-up an aircraft's GPS can be tens of metres wrong about its own height above sea level. In one crash that put the first survey waypoint below the takeoff point, and the aircraft flew into the ground on the way to it. Missions flown at a fixed height above the takeoff point are not affected.

• In the save wizard the Terrain Follow option is greyed out. A mission saved earlier with terrain following on cannot be uploaded until it is set to Relative Alt: open it, go through the wizard, choose Relative Alt and save.

• The app chooser no longer flashes up for a moment while an update installs.

Installing over the top keeps your missions and settings.
